title: Polish Beet Bake
description: A hearty, comforting dish featuring the earthy flavors of beets and the savory taste of Polish sausage.
instructions: Cut the beets into 1-inch pieces and place them in a baking dish.
Add 1 tablespoon of umami to the beets and toss to coat.
Slice the Polish sausage and add it to the baking dish.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and top the beets and sausage with the crushed bake.
Return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with additional umami if desired.
